children: Equity Bancshares reported non-interest income of $10.9 million in 3Q, up $2.8 million from the prior quarter. Adjusted for one-time items in 2Q, non-interest income increased $600,000, driven by growth across service charges, treasury services, debit and credit card income, and trust and wealth management revenue. Year over year, non-interest income excluding gains or losses on security sales increased 22.8%.
